name: docker_open5gs (herlesupreeth)
description: Docker containerization of complete 4G/5G telecom network including Open5GS core, IMS (Kamailio/OpenSIPS), srsRAN, UERANSIM, and supporting infrastructure. 19+ deployment scenarios.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker pull ghcr.io/herlesupreeth/docker_open5gs:master; docker compose -f sa-deploy.yaml up

eval_notes: Most feature-rich Docker deployment of Open5GS. Includes IMS/VoLTE/VoNR which no other Docker wrapper provides. Excellent for testing voice services over 5G. Multiple deployment scenarios (4G, 5G SA, IMS). Most complete all-in-one Docker environment for 5G/4G testing. Supports VoLTE/VoNR with IMS. Multiple RAN options (srsRAN SDR/ZMQ, UERANSIM). Ideal for end-to-end agentic evals requiring full network stack. Most comprehensive Docker-based telecom lab with 521 stars. Full 4G+5G+IMS stack with multiple deployment scenarios. Covers Diameter, SCTP, GTP, PFCP, SIP signaling. Gold standard for multi-protocol agentic evaluations.
